description: Angular component for managing JavaScript function modules, including form controls, validation, and user interactions.

classes.name: JsFuncModulesComponent
classes.description: Angular component for handling JavaScript function modules with form validation and user interaction.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and controls based on input modules.

methods.name: applyModules
methods.description: Emits the list of valid modules when user applies changes.

methods.name: moduleAliasUnique
methods.description: Checks if a module alias is unique within the form array.

methods.name: modulesFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of modules.

methods.name: trackByModule
methods.description: Track function for module controls in templates.

methods.name: removeModule
methods.description: Removes a module control at specified index.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a new empty module control to the form array.
